en.headline: Anti-ram bollards installation begins outside Sogo in Causeway Bay
en.dek: Workers had installed four fixed bollards by Wednesday afternoon along the pavement outside the department store as part of a HK$5 million project against vehicle-ramming risks.
body: Installation of anti-ram bollards has begun at a busy pedestrian crossing outside the Sogo department store in Causeway Bay, with four fixed bollards in place along the pavement by Wednesday afternoon, according to reports.

The project, estimated to cost about HK$5 million, aims to provide a physical barrier against vehicles deliberately mounting crowded pedestrian areas. Officials had earlier identified vehicle-ramming attacks as a long-standing risk in the major commercial and tourist district.

The work covers locations around the crossing at 555 Hennessy Road and the nearby Paterson Street pedestrian precinct. Some delivery workers and visitors have expressed mixed views, with one delivery worker saying the barriers could hinder routine access and a resident questioning the impact on the streetscape. Construction continued behind temporary barriers.

zh.headline: 銅鑼灣崇光百貨外防撞柱安裝工程展開
zh.dek: 周三下午工人已在百貨公司外行人路安裝四支固定防撞柱，屬約500萬元項目，旨在防範車輛衝撞風險。
body: 據報，銅鑼灣崇光百貨外繁忙行人過路處的防撞柱安裝工程已經展開，周三下午行人路上已裝妥四支固定防撞柱。
項目估計開支約500萬元，旨在為行人提供物理屏障，防止車輛故意衝上擁擠的行人區域。當局早前已將車輛衝撞攻擊視為這個主要商業及旅遊區的長期風險。
工程涵蓋軒尼詩道555號外過路處及附近百德新街行人專用區。部分送貨工人及途人反應不一，有送貨工人指屏障可能妨礙日常進出，亦有居民質疑對街道景觀的影響。工程在臨時圍欄後繼續進行。
